name: clipcommerce-analyst
description: Evidence-led video commerce analysis and adaptable team-context feedback for local CSV/XLSX exports.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze exports and adapt recommendations to a team's work context.
interface.longDescription: Maps local video, advertising and commerce exports into transparent funnel analysis, then returns evidence-led, human-approved feedback adapted to a team's own goals and constraints.
interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze my local video-commerce export and team work context. First state what is known and missing, then identify evidence-backed strengths, gaps, and human-approved next actions.
